## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
```

## Download raw data from GEO (only if not already present)

The three supplementary tables of GEO series GSE311689 are downloaded into
`data/_raw/`. The `data/` folder is listed in `.gitignore`, so the data never
go to GitHub.

The download links are copied from the "(http)" link next to each file under
"Supplementary file" on the GEO page (right click → copy link address).
The local file names are the names GEO gives the files.

```{r}
raw_dir <- "../data/_raw/"

# Paste the exact links from the GEO page here
geo_links <- c(
  asv  = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE311nnn/GSE311689/suppl/GSE311689%5FASV%5Ftable%2Etsv%2Egz",
  tax  = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE311nnn/GSE311689/suppl/GSE311689%5Fsample%5Fmetadata%2Etsv%2Egz",
  meta = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE311nnn/GSE311689/suppl/GSE311689%5Ftaxonomy%5Ftable%2Etsv%2Egz"
)

raw_files <- c(
  asv  = "GSE311689_ASV_table.tsv",
  tax  = "GSE311689_taxonomy_table.tsv",
  meta = "GSE311689_sample_metadata.tsv"
)

if (!dir.exists(raw_dir)) {
  dir.create(path = raw_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

for (table_name in names(raw_files)) {
  destination <- str_c(raw_dir, raw_files[table_name])
  if (!file.exists(destination)) {
    download.file(url = geo_links[table_name],
                  destfile = destination,
                  mode = "wb")
  }
}
```

## Read raw data

All columns are read as character first, so nothing is silently converted.
Types are fixed explicitly in `02_clean.qmd`. The exception is the ASV count
table, which only holds integer counts.

```{r}
asv_raw <- read_tsv(file = str_c(raw_dir, raw_files["asv"]))

tax_raw <- read_tsv(file = str_c(raw_dir, raw_files["tax"]),
                    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

meta_raw <- read_tsv(file = str_c(raw_dir, raw_files["meta"]),
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
```

## Write data

```{r}
write_tsv(x = asv_raw, file = "../data/01_dat_load_asv.tsv")
write_tsv(x = tax_raw, file = "../data/01_dat_load_tax.tsv")
write_tsv(x = meta_raw, file = "../data/01_dat_load_meta.tsv")
```
